prompt: OCC reusable HD2D scene asset, original near-modern magical academy visual language. Clean Japanese game illustration with tactile painted sprite materials and restrained pixel-inspired edges; BEAUTY AND COHESIVE STYLE FIRST, no strict pixel grid or pixel quantization. Paper ivory/cream rather than white, walnut brown and desaturated dark teal covers, small aged brass fittings, muted cyan glass. Calm broad value shapes, crisp readable silhouette, restrained fine detail, no gritty noise, no grunge, no ornate medieval fantasy or excessive steampunk gears. Front facing, zero yaw, camera-parallel main face, subtle shallow overhead reveal, no dramatic perspective. Soft neutral upper-left form shading, low contrast, NO warm orange lighting, NO glow, NO atmospheric haze, NO external cast shadow, no floor or scene. ONE complete isolated object on genuine transparent alpha background with generous transparent padding. Blank surfaces for dynamic Chinese text, no letters, numbers, symbols pretending to be text, decorative pseudo-writing, labels or UI mockup. Same material family and lighting throughout. SUBJECT: A broad open student dossier, two wide blank ivory writing pages with softly bowed top contours and layered lower page edges, a narrow central walnut binding with restrained brass rings, small desaturated teal cloth cover protruding around edges. Very generous clean writing space. Physically believable thin paper stack, elegant restrained hardware. The two pages are flat toward camera for live text; book volume shown in spine and perimeter.
